name: CK-MB/cTnI Fast Test Kit
description: quantitative determination of CK-MB/cTnI in serum, plasma or whole blood sanples. This test is used as an aid in the clinical diagnosis, prognosis and evaluation of myocardial injury such as Acute Myocardial Infarction (AMI), Unstable Angina, Acute Myocarditis and Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS).
